location_note: Spec T10 placed this under configs/research/; T11 was told not to modify configs/research, so it lives here. Moving it is a coordinator/user decision; the content is the registration.
scope: Prospective, advisory-only evaluation of the VN30 swing desk. Already inspected history is development data, never a holdout. A green result does not approve trading.

arms.desk: D: repaired VeriHarness deliverable (4 analyst rollouts + ELIM/FALS investigations + adjudication + repair)
arms.single: D1: analyst rollout a1 (fixed in advance) before any verification; measures what VeriHarness adds
arms.baseline: B: S1 or S2 with structural gate PASS, lowest RSI(2) first, top 3
arms.control: C: 3 random tickers with structural gate PASS ignoring G11, seeded by target session date (YYYYMMDD)
arms.user_check: every pre-trade check (checks.jsonl), for H4 only

structural_gate: G0-G8 + G11; G9 (portfolio) and G10 (events) excluded because they are identical for all arms

common_plan.entry: limit = close_t x 1.005, valid on the next session (analyst arms may use ATO or another limit, recorded per row)
common_plan.target: SMA20 when a setup exists, else 20-session high; rows with target <= entry are not generated

freeze: all rows appended to swing_desk/recommendations/recommendations.jsonl before 09:00 VN of the target session; baseline and control frozen by code before any analyst runs; hash chain + head sidecar; no edits or deletions

scoring.fill: limit fills if L <= limit at min(O, limit); ATO at O; otherwise no_fill (counted, not dropped)
scoring.lock: no exits on target session i and i+1
scoring.day2: session i+2 is close-only: stop touched during lock or C <= stop -> exit at C; C >= target -> exit at C
scoring.after_day2: O <= stop -> O; L <= stop -> stop; O >= target -> O; H >= target -> target; stop first on the same bar
scoring.limit_down: a stop exit on a session with close-to-close <= -6.5% is assumed unfilled and carried to the next open
scoring.pending: rows whose path is not complete in the newest verified snapshot stay pending

hypotheses.H1: mean net return per recommendation D > B, paired by session (primary)
hypotheses.H2: Brier skill of p_win_stated > 0 against the arm's own base win rate
hypotheses.H4: user trades tagged PASS have higher mean net than WARN/BLOCK/NONE; descriptive until >= 30 trades per group

analysis: weekly block bootstrap 95% CI for D - B; must be positive in both halves of the period and at 0.6% cost; report no-fill rate, monthly new ideas, zero-idea months; distinguish positive net profit from losing less than VNINDEX

activity_floor.rule: reported per month; never force ideas or loosen gates to meet it

decision: 'desk beats rule-only' only if the CI > 0 and all stresses pass; otherwise 'not proven'. Any change to rules, prompts or model starts a new protocol version and resets counts.
